description:
We are CyberAstro, a four-person team: Nurlana Nurullayeva, Nikita Shvedov, Ayesha Aliyeva and Rəna Rüstəmli. We love space, health tech and software that works when nothing else does.

For the "Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions" challenge we built ORBITA (Onboard Remote Biometric & Integrated Telemetry Assistant).
